QuestInfo.name: Ellinia, the Town of Fairies
QuestInfo.0: #m101000000#'s famous magician, #p1032001#, has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: #p1032001# suggested that you become friends with the fairies in #m101000000# if you plan on staying in #m101000000#. Go talk to #b#p1032101##k, the leader of the fairies and a friend of humans. #b#p1032101##k can be found #bright of the center of  #m101000000##k.
